candidates.reason: The left column is cleanly aligned, but this is a shrunk copy of the square layout rather than a reflow for the new shape. The bottom ~170px is dead empty, the cover floats small and mid-right, the logo is tiny and the legal line is very small.

Reads well top to bottom, and the cover sits beside the CTA to fill the lower half. But the headline hangs at x≈38 while the bullets and CTA sit at x≈64, so the edges are ragged. The headline crowds the logo, and the CTA, legal line and cover are packed toward the bottom while the right of the bullets is empty.

The benefit list is broken apart: bullet 2 is a tiny orphan at the top right, bullet 3 is dropped to the bottom-left corner, and the three use different type sizes. The legal line wraps into a narrow column jammed against the right edge beside the CTA. The oversized cover dominates and pushes the CTA to the bottom edge.

Best vertical flow, with comfortable top and bottom margins and the cover anchoring the lower right next to the CTA. The headline (x≈40) still doesn't share an edge with the bullets and CTA (x≈60), and the logo is centred on its own axis. A large empty gap sits between the list and the CTA on the left, and the cover is only loosely related to the CTA.
